description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Notification No.01/2025 Excise Duty on Liquor
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notification that establishes new excise duty rates on various types of liquor under the Excise Ordinance. It exercises statutory powers to create binding regulations, rescinds previous notification No. 04/2023, and functions as subsidiary legislation. While it mentions Minister Anura Kumara Dissanayake, it does so only to identify the authority issuing the regulation and does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would trigger a government-related classification (Types 1-3).
